clues.title: THE PAIRED RESERVES
clues.caption: ETH and ERC20 label the two chambers. Together they represent one V1 exchange's paired reserves. Pouring into both suggests providing liquidity; a swap instead adds one asset and removes some of the other.

clues.title: THE CONSTANT-PRODUCT PLATE
clues.caption: The x*y=k engraving recalls the pricing rule. The reserve ratio changes as trades occur. Fees and liquidity changes affect the reserve product, so the inscription does not promise a fixed price or an unchanging k.

clues.title: THE V1 BADGE
clues.caption: V1 identifies the original protocol generation. Its exchanges paired a token with ETH, and token-to-token swaps could route through ETH. The badge keeps the scene distinct from later Uniswap versions.

clues.title: THE LAUNCH DATE
clues.caption: 2 NOV 2018 marks the public launch on Ethereum mainnet during Devcon 4 in Prague. It is visible on the engine in the full artwork and repeated at the top of the framed card.
